intent: Semantic layer for the study: releases, labs, cadence gaps and rate tests, with before/after/change metric families, access and openness shares, and METHODOLOGY sensitivity variants

edits.new_content:
version: 2

semantic_models:
  - name: release_candidates
    description: >
      Every candidate release in the research, counted or not (fct_release_candidates).
      Most metrics filter to is_counted, the METHODOLOGY main definition.
    model: ref('fct_release_candidates')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: release_date
    entities:
      - name: release
        type: primary
        expr: release_id
      - name: lab
        type: foreign
        expr: lab_id
    dimensions:
      - name: release_date
        label: Release date
        type: time
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
      - name: essay_window
        label: Essay window
        description: before (30 days before 12 Sep 2026), after (30 days after), essay_day or outside.
        type: categorical
      - name: essay_period
        label: Essay period (10-day, signed)
        description: -3..-1 before the essay, +1..+3 after; equal 10-day periods.
        type: categorical
      - name: essay_period_label
        label: Essay period
        type: categorical
      - name: days_from_essay
        label: Days from essay
        type: categorical
      - name: model_name
        label: Model
        type: categorical
      - name: tier_band
        label: Tier band
        description: flagship, upper, mid, small_fast or not_classified.
        type: categorical
      - name: tier_rank
        label: Tier rank
        type: categorical
      - name: is_top_tier
        label: Top tier
        type: categorical
      - name: top_tier_kind
        label: Top-tier kind
        description: new_flagship, flagship_refresh, below_flagship or not_assessed.
        type: categorical
      - name: access_level
        label: Access level at announcement
        type: categorical
      - name: is_generally_available
        label: Generally available
        type: categorical
      - name: is_restricted_access
        label: Restricted access
        type: categorical
      - name: is_announced_only
        label: Announced only
        type: categorical
      - name: has_gated_variant
        label: Has gated variant
        type: categorical
      - name: open_weights_status
        label: Open weights status
        type: categorical
      - name: is_open_weights
        label: Open weights
        type: categorical
      - name: is_snapshot_update
        label: Snapshot update
        type: categorical
      - name: is_staggered_rollout
        label: Staggered rollout
        type: categorical
      - name: launch_event
        label: Launch event
        type: categorical
      - name: release_weekday
        label: Weekday
        type: categorical
      - name: is_weekend
        label: Weekend release
        type: categorical
      - name: is_counted
        label: Counted (main definition)
        type: categorical
      - name: exclusion_category
        label: Exclusion category
        type: categorical
      - name: is_borderline_lab
        label: Borderline lab
        type: categorical
      - name: is_counted_released_only
        label: Counted, released only
        type: categorical
      - name: is_counted_incl_borderline
        label: Counted, incl. borderline labs
        type: categorical
      - name: has_date_conflict
        label: Date conflict
        type: categorical
      - name: essay_window_alt_date
        label: Essay window (conflicting dates)
        description: The window under the conflicting dates in METHODOLOGY 7.1 (worst case).
        type: categorical
      - name: is_window_date_sensitive
        label: Window depends on disputed date
        type: categorical
      - name: source_type
        label: Source type
        description: vendor, tracker, press or aggregator (METHODOLOGY 5).
        type: categorical
      - name: source_domain
        label: Source domain
        type: categorical
    measures:
      - name: release_count
        label: Releases
        description: Number of candidate rows; metrics narrow it with filters.
        agg: sum
        expr: "1"
      - name: lab_count
        label: Labs
        description: Distinct labs among the rows a metric selects.
        agg: count_distinct
        expr: lab_id

  - name: labs
    description: One row per lab (dim_labs), with geography and recorded essay stance.
    model: ref('dim_labs')
    entities:
      - name: lab
        type: primary
        expr: lab_id
    dimensions:
      - name: lab_name
        label: Lab
        type: categorical
      - name: region
        label: Region
        type: categorical
      - name: parent_country
        label: Parent country
        type: categorical
      - name: essay_coordination_group
        label: Essay coordination group
        description: us_frontier_company, other_democracy or china.
        type: categorical
      - name: essay_stance
        label: Essay stance
        description: author, endorsed_publicly or none_recorded.
        type: categorical
      - name: is_author_or_endorser
        label: Wrote or endorsed the essay
        type: categorical
      - name: lab_scope
        label: Lab scope
        type: categorical

  - name: release_gaps
    description: >
      One row per pair of consecutive days with a counted release (rpt_release_gaps).
      gap_position separates gaps inside each window from the one spanning the essay.
    model: ref('rpt_release_gaps')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: gap_end_date
    entities:
      - name: gap
        type: primary
        expr: gap_id
    dimensions:
      - name: gap_end_date
        label: Gap end date
        type: time
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
      - name: gap_position
        label: Gap position
        type: categorical
      - name: start_window
        label: Gap start window
        type: categorical
      - name: end_window
        label: Gap end window
        type: categorical
    measures:
      - name: gap_count
        label: Gaps
        agg: sum
        expr: "1"
      - name: max_gap_days
        label: Longest gap (days)
        agg: max
        expr: gap_days
      - name: avg_gap_days
        label: Average gap (days)
        agg: average
        expr: gap_days

  - name: rate_tests
    description: >
      One row per before/after comparison (rpt_rate_tests). Measures are per-comparison
      values, so always group by rate_test__comparison_id; totals across comparisons mean nothing.
    model: ref('rpt_rate_tests')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: essay_date
    entities:
      - name: rate_test
        type: primary
        expr: comparison_id
    dimensions:
      - name: essay_date
        label: Essay date
        type: time
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
      - name: comparison_id
        label: Comparison
        type: categorical
      - name: comparison_order
        label: Comparison order
        type: categorical
      - name: comparison_group
        label: Comparison group
        type: categorical
      - name: comparison_label
        label: Comparison label
        type: categorical
    measures:
      - name: test_before_count
        label: Before
        agg: max
        expr: before_count
      - name: test_after_count
        label: After
        agg: max
        expr: after_count
      - name: test_change
        label: Change
        agg: max
        expr: change
      - name: test_rate_ratio
        label: Rate ratio (after / before)
        agg: max
        expr: rate_ratio
      - name: test_p_value
        label: p-value (two-sided, exact)
        agg: max
        expr: p_value_two_sided
      - name: test_p_value_bonferroni
        label: p-value (Bonferroni)
        agg: max
        expr: p_value_bonferroni

version: 2

metrics:
  - name: frontier_releases
    label: Frontier releases
    description: >
      Counted frontier model releases: the METHODOLOGY main definition (13 labs, general-purpose LLMs, new models, first announcement).
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true"
  - name: frontier_releases_before
    label: Frontier releases, 30 days before the essay
    description: >
      Counted frontier model releases: the METHODOLOGY main definition (13 labs, general-purpose LLMs, new models, first announcement). Restricted to the 30 days before the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'before'"
  - name: frontier_releases_after
    label: Frontier releases, 30 days after the essay
    description: >
      Counted frontier model releases: the METHODOLOGY main definition (13 labs, general-purpose LLMs, new models, first announcement). Restricted to the 30 days after the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'after'"
  - name: frontier_releases_change
    label: Frontier releases, change (after minus before)
    description: >
      frontier_releases_after minus frontier_releases_before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: frontier_releases_after - frontier_releases_before
      metrics:
        - name: frontier_releases_after
        - name: frontier_releases_before
  - name: frontier_releases_change_pct
    label: Frontier releases, change (% of before)
    description: >
      (after - before) / before; null when nothing was released before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (frontier_releases_after - frontier_releases_before) * 1.0 / nullif(frontier_releases_before, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: frontier_releases_after
        - name: frontier_releases_before
  - name: top_tier_releases
    label: Top-tier releases
    description: >
      Counted releases the researcher flagged top_tier: the lab's most capable model or a new flagship generation at announcement.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_top_tier') }} = true"
  - name: top_tier_releases_before
    label: Top-tier releases, 30 days before the essay
    description: >
      Counted releases the researcher flagged top_tier: the lab's most capable model or a new flagship generation at announcement. Restricted to the 30 days before the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_top_tier') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'before'"
  - name: top_tier_releases_after
    label: Top-tier releases, 30 days after the essay
    description: >
      Counted releases the researcher flagged top_tier: the lab's most capable model or a new flagship generation at announcement. Restricted to the 30 days after the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_top_tier') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'after'"
  - name: top_tier_releases_change
    label: Top-tier releases, change (after minus before)
    description: >
      top_tier_releases_after minus top_tier_releases_before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: top_tier_releases_after - top_tier_releases_before
      metrics:
        - name: top_tier_releases_after
        - name: top_tier_releases_before
  - name: top_tier_releases_change_pct
    label: Top-tier releases, change (% of before)
    description: >
      (after - before) / before; null when nothing was released before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (top_tier_releases_after - top_tier_releases_before) * 1.0 / nullif(top_tier_releases_before, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: top_tier_releases_after
        - name: top_tier_releases_before
  - name: new_flagship_releases
    label: New flagship releases
    description: >
      Top-tier releases that are not point or snapshot updates of an existing flagship.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__top_tier_kind') }} = 'new_flagship'"
  - name: new_flagship_releases_before
    label: New flagship releases, 30 days before the essay
    description: >
      Top-tier releases that are not point or snapshot updates of an existing flagship. Restricted to the 30 days before the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__top_tier_kind') }} = 'new_flagship' and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'before'"
  - name: new_flagship_releases_after
    label: New flagship releases, 30 days after the essay
    description: >
      Top-tier releases that are not point or snapshot updates of an existing flagship. Restricted to the 30 days after the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__top_tier_kind') }} = 'new_flagship' and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'after'"
  - name: new_flagship_releases_change
    label: New flagship releases, change (after minus before)
    description: >
      new_flagship_releases_after minus new_flagship_releases_before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: new_flagship_releases_after - new_flagship_releases_before
      metrics:
        - name: new_flagship_releases_after
        - name: new_flagship_releases_before
  - name: new_flagship_releases_change_pct
    label: New flagship releases, change (% of before)
    description: >
      (after - before) / before; null when nothing was released before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (new_flagship_releases_after - new_flagship_releases_before) * 1.0 / nullif(new_flagship_releases_before, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: new_flagship_releases_after
        - name: new_flagship_releases_before
  - name: labs_shipping
    label: Labs shipping
    description: >
      Distinct labs with at least one counted release.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: lab_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true"
  - name: labs_shipping_before
    label: Labs shipping, 30 days before the essay
    description: >
      Distinct labs with at least one counted release. Restricted to the 30 days before the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: lab_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'before'"
  - name: labs_shipping_after
    label: Labs shipping, 30 days after the essay
    description: >
      Distinct labs with at least one counted release. Restricted to the 30 days after the essay.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: lab_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__essay_window') }} = 'after'"
  - name: labs_shipping_change
    label: Labs shipping, change (after minus before)
    description: >
      labs_shipping_after minus labs_shipping_before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: labs_shipping_after - labs_shipping_before
      metrics:
        - name: labs_shipping_after
        - name: labs_shipping_before
  - name: labs_shipping_change_pct
    label: Labs shipping, change (% of before)
    description: >
      (after - before) / before; null when nothing was released before.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (labs_shipping_after - labs_shipping_before) * 1.0 / nullif(labs_shipping_before, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: labs_shipping_after
        - name: labs_shipping_before
  - name: generally_available_releases
    label: Generally available releases
    description: >
      Counted releases generally available on their announcement date.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_generally_available') }} = true"
  - name: restricted_access_releases
    label: Restricted-access releases
    description: >
      Counted releases that were preview or limited, gated, or announced only on their announcement date.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_restricted_access') }} = true"
  - name: open_weights_releases
    label: Open-weights releases
    description: >
      Counted releases with weights at launch or promised for later.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = true and {{ Dimension('release__is_open_weights') }} = true"
  - name: generally_available_share
    label: Share generally available
    description: >
      generally_available_releases / frontier_releases. A ratio: never sum it across groups.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: generally_available_releases
      denominator: frontier_releases
  - name: restricted_access_share
    label: Share with restricted access
    description: >
      restricted_access_releases / frontier_releases. A ratio: never sum it across groups.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: restricted_access_releases
      denominator: frontier_releases
  - name: open_weights_share
    label: Share with open weights
    description: >
      open_weights_releases / frontier_releases. A ratio: never sum it across groups.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: open_weights_releases
      denominator: frontier_releases
  - name: top_tier_share
    label: Share top tier
    description: >
      top_tier_releases / frontier_releases. A ratio: never sum it across groups.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: top_tier_releases
      denominator: frontier_releases
  - name: frontier_releases_released_only
    label: Frontier releases, released only
    description: >
      METHODOLOGY 7.2 variant: the main definition without announced-only models (drops Qwen4).
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted_released_only') }} = true"
  - name: frontier_releases_incl_borderline
    label: Frontier releases, incl. borderline labs
    description: >
      METHODOLOGY 7.2 variant: the main definition plus in-window releases from Xiaomi, StepFun, Meituan and Sakana AI.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted_incl_borderline') }} = true"
  - name: excluded_candidates
    label: Excluded candidates
    description: >
      Candidate rows that fail the inclusion rules; group by exclusion_category.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
    filter: "{{ Dimension('release__is_counted') }} = false"
  - name: release_candidates
    label: Release candidates
    description: >
      Every candidate row the research recorded, counted or not.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure:
        name: release_count
        fill_nulls_with: 0
  - name: release_gaps
    label: Gaps between release days
    description: >
      Pairs of consecutive days with a counted release.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: gap_count
  - name: longest_gap_days
    label: Longest gap (days)
    description: >
      Longest run between consecutive counted release days. Not additive.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: max_gap_days
  - name: average_gap_days
    label: Average gap (days)
    description: >
      Average days between consecutive counted release days. Not additive.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: avg_gap_days
  - name: rate_test_before
    label: Before (test)
    description: >
      Releases in the before window for one comparison. Group by rate_test__comparison_id.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_before_count
  - name: rate_test_after
    label: After (test)
    description: >
      Releases in the after window for one comparison. Group by rate_test__comparison_id.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_after_count
  - name: rate_test_change
    label: Change (test)
    description: >
      after - before for one comparison.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_change
  - name: rate_test_rate_ratio
    label: Rate ratio (test)
    description: >
      after / before for one comparison; null when before is 0.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_rate_ratio
  - name: rate_test_p_value
    label: p-value (exact, two-sided)
    description: >
      Exact conditional binomial test of equal release rates in both windows.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_p_value
  - name: rate_test_p_value_bonferroni
    label: p-value (Bonferroni)
    description: >
      The exact p-value times the number of comparisons, capped at 1.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: test_p_value_bonferroni
